title: Safe-Zone Edge Pacing Alert
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:position boundary_state=near_edge
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as edge_events by pet_name _time
| where edge_events>5
| sort - edge_events
description: Watches for repeated GPS positions right on the edge of the safe zone, which can indicate fence curiosity, route changes, or a pet testing boundaries.
value: Edge pacing is often the pattern right before a genuine escape event, making it more actionable than a simple geofence exit alert.
implementation: Forward safe-zone state from the pet tracker; alert when edge events bunch up in a short period.
visualization: Hourly chart of geofence edge events by pet.

references.title: Tractive GPS for dogs and cats

grandmaExplanation: It compares when your pet keeps hanging around the border of the safe area as if it might try to leave.
